purpose: Turn M7A exploratory trigger signatures into a small frozen independent proxy kernel and test stability without using trade outcomes or further same-window threshold optimization.

candidate_kernel_priority.reason: RCI9 turn-up recurred across ALL, BTCUSD and XAUUSD reports. Context filter differs by scope and must not be selected by outcome.
RCI9 turn-down captured all 10 primary SHORT events in the combined observation window.
Opposite RCI upper extreme was the stable exit signature, but exact secondary condition differs by scope.
Opposite RCI lower extreme was the stable exit signature, but two of ten combined events were missed by the best strict pair.

reentry_policy.REENTRY_LONG: DO_NOT_FREEZE_RULE; only one combined event and zero XAUUSD positives
reentry_policy.REENTRY_SHORT: OBSERVE_ONLY; four combined events and one XAUUSD event are insufficient

m7b_required_outputs: Frozen candidate-rule manifest with IDs and no trade-outcome fields
No-event false-positive table and clustering by ticker/time
Per-ticker cross-check showing which core signatures survive BTCUSD/XAUUSD separation
Leave-one-event-out or equivalent sensitivity audit for threshold dependence
Explicit list of rules rejected as one-sample or scope-specific artifacts
PASS/BLOCKED decision for prospective M7C shadow reproduction
m7b_guardrails: Do not use M6A/M6B/M6C returns, MFE, MAE, win/loss, or EXIT profitability to select trigger conditions.
Do not use alert-bar high, low, or close.
Use only the last fully closed M15 bar and the new M15 open available at decision time.
Do not treat pre-collector history as verified no-alert data.
Do not claim exact proprietary formula reconstruction.
Do not approve historical full-scan, cross-timeframe extraction, entry gates, alerts, orders, live readiness, or final signals.
Do not tune a large rule family until it reproduces the current genuine events with stable false-positive behavior.
Preserve source event identity from Webhook/SQLite; chart label redraw is not required for reentries.
after_m7b: M7C prospective shadow reproduction against newly collected genuine alerts
Only after M7C stability: historical candidate extraction on full CSV as independent proxy candidates
Only after historical audit: M5/H1 and other timeframe mapping with timeframe-specific recalculation and validation
